info.name: CampusRide QA Lab API tests
info.description: Run once from the first folder on a fresh local demo seed with DEMO_BUG_MODE=false. The environment supplies fictional credentials. Session cookies and IDs live only in the run. See api-testing/README.md for setup and reset instructions.

variable.description: Shared JSON schemas for positive and negative API responses.

exec: pm.test('Use a local HTTP base_url with an explicit port', function () {
// The OpenAPI document describes credential inputs. It contains no account responses.
pm.test('Response contains no passwords, session secrets, or phone fields', function () {
